魔法少女的天敌"},{"paragraph":2,"text":"“我是风信子，已经接到报告，正在赶往绿心公园！”"},{"paragraph":3,"text":"天空中划过一道天蓝的轨迹，人们纷纷抬头张望指指点点，可流星般划过整个蓉城上空的天蓝色少女心情却并没有那么美妙——"},{"paragraph":4,"text":"魔法少女风信子，真名南小风。"},{"paragraph":5,"text":"今天是开学前的第二天，南小风本来在家里郁闷地补着暑假作业，可来自英雄协会的一条紧急通讯却打断了她补作业的所有期望："},{"paragraph":6,"text":"【蓉城绿心公园出现怪人袭击，立刻前往支援】"},{"paragraph":7,"text":"这让南小风今天的心情非常不好。"},{"paragraph":8,"text":"她暗暗决定了一件事，今天这只袭击绿心公园的怪人绝对不会有什么好下场。"},{"paragraph":9,"text":"."},{"paragraph":10,"text":"“啪嗒。”"},{"paragraph":11,"text":"少女足尖轻巧落地，握紧手中魔杖，环顾四周。"},{"paragraph":12,"text":"绿心公园原本布满了路灯照明，此时却是一片昏黑，居民们早已被疏散离开，周围安静得出奇，只能听到晚夏时节那悠悠的蝉叫虫鸣。"},{"paragraph":13,"text":"南小风默默地将魔杖攥紧了些。"},{"paragraph":14,"text":"“真安静啊。”魔法少女风信子小声说道。"},{"paragraph":15,"text":"回答她的是身边那只模样如白貂般的奇妙生物："},{"paragraph":16,"text":"“当心，小风，这附近有怪人的气息。”"},{"paragraph":17,"text":"“我当然知道有怪人，咱们接到的报告不就说这里出现了怪人袭击事件吗。”南小风没好气地回了一句。"},{"paragraph":18,"text":"天蓝色的魔法少女迈开脚步，一边警惕四周，一边朝散发出魔力气息的方向快步走去。"},{"paragraph":19,"text":"这并不是她第一次应对怪人袭击。"},{"paragraph":20,"text":"半年前，离家出走的南小风遇到了身边这只白貂——自称白灵的观星者精灵，在他的引导下获得了一枚守护之星，从此便以魔法少女【风信子】的身份活跃于蓉城。"},{"paragraph":21,"text":"这期间出现了十几起英雄协会无法处理的怪人袭击事件，南小风便担此重任，屡次成功解决，【风信子】也顺利成为蓉城民众常常谈论的话题。"},{"paragraph":22,"text":"“这边，这边的气息最强烈！”"},{"paragraph":23,"text":"白灵飘在空中左闻右看，突然这么叫了一声，便朝着某个方向飞去。"},{"paragraph":24,"text":"南小风急忙跟上。"},{"paragraph":25,"text":"“慢点！白灵你慢点！”"},{"paragraph":26,"text":"“稍微等我一下——”"},{"paragraph":27,"text":"穿过树丛，南小风话音未落，脚下步伐猛然停住，被眼前的一幕给镇住："},{"paragraph":28,"text":"眼前是一片空地，原本摆放着小孩子们爬上爬下的游乐设施与沙坑，此时已经荡然无存，只剩一片残垣断壁。"},{"paragraph":29,"text":"在废墟中间趴着一只体型巨大的黑色怪物，四肢蜷缩匍匐在地，听到耳边传来窸窣声响便转过头来，朝南小风投以它那狠厉的视线。"},{"paragraph":30,"text":"“咔啦！”"},{"paragraph":31,"text":"魔法少女风信子立即摆开战斗姿势，魔杖在手中化作大剑，警惕着眼前这只狼形怪物的一举一动。"},{"paragraph":32,"text":"“这家伙……好强烈的魔力气息……”白灵飞回南小风身旁，小声说道，“当心，这是个很厉害的怪人！”"},{"paragraph":33,"text":"南小风没有接话，鬓侧落下一滴冷汗。"},{"paragraph":34,"text":"怪人并不局限于人形，各种形态都有，眼前这只狼形怪物正散发出剧烈的魔力气息，这是所有怪人都会拥有的特征。"},{"paragraph":35,"text":"可自己揍过的十几只怪人里面，还没有哪个能比得上眼前这只黑狼。"},{"paragraph":36,"text":"“……赶紧解决掉，然后回家补作业吧！”"},{"paragraph":37," ext":"魔杖","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":59,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":64,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":97,"text":"大剑","occurrence":0,"name":true}]},{"id":"MoFaShaonv","mentions":[{"paragraph":4,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":14,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":20,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":31,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":61,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":84,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true},{"paragraph":89,"text":"魔法少女","occurrence":0,"name":true}]}],"disclosures":[{"id":"D1","from":2,"to":2,"text":"风信子自称已接到报告，正在赶往绿心公园。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["LvXinGongYuan"]},{"id":"D2","from":3,"to":4,"text":"天空中划过天蓝色轨迹，人们纷纷抬头张望；天蓝色少女是魔法少女风信子，真名南小风。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","RongCheng"]},{"id":"D3","from":5,"to":5,"text":"今天是开学前第二天，南小风本来在家补暑假作业，却被英雄协会的一条紧急通讯打断。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","YingXiongXieHui"]},{"id":"D4","from":6,"to":6,"text":"通讯内容为：蓉城绿心公园出现怪人袭击，要求立刻前往支援。","channel":"document","mode":"request","holder":"YingXiongXieHui","about":["RongCheng","LvXinGongYuan","GuaiRen"]},{"id":"D5","from":7,"to":8,"text":"南小风今天心情非常不好，并暗暗决定要让袭击绿心公园的怪人没有好下场。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["GuaiRen","LvXinGongYuan"]},{"id":"D6","from":10,"to":13,"text":"少女足尖轻巧落地，握紧魔杖环顾；绿心公园原本有路灯却一片昏黑，居民已被疏散，周围安静得只能听到晚夏虫鸣。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","MoZhang","LvXinGongYuan"]},{"id":"D7","from":14,"to":14,"text":"风信子小声说：“真安静啊。”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"FengXinZi","about":[]},{"id":"D8","from":15,"to":16,"text":"白灵警告南小风，这附近有怪人的气息。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"BaiLing","about":["FengXinZi","GuaiRen"]},{"id":"D9","from":17,"to":17,"text":"南小风没好气地回应，报告已经说明这里出现怪人袭击事件。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["GuaiRen","LvXinGongYuan"]},{"id":"D10","from":18,"to":21,"text":"南小风不是第一次应对怪人袭击；半年前离家出走的她遇到白灵——自称观星者精灵，在他的引导下获得守护之星，从此以魔法少女风信子身份活跃于蓉城。这期间她成功解决十几起英雄协会无法处理的怪人袭击，风信子也成为蓉城民众常谈论的话题。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","BaiLing","GuanXingZhe","ShouHuZhiXing","MoFaShaonv","YingXiongXieHui","GuaiRen","RongCheng"]},{"id":"D11","from":22,"to":23,"text":"白灵说这边的气息最强烈，便朝某个方向飞去。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["BaiLing"]},{"id":"D12","from":27,"to":29,"text":"穿过树丛后，南小风停住脚步，看到原本有游乐设施与沙坑的空地已成废墟；废墟中趴着一只体型巨大的黑色狼形怪物，它转头以狠厉视线看向南小风。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","LvXinGongYuan","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D13","from":31,"to":31,"text":"魔法少女风信子摆出战斗姿势，魔杖化作大剑，警惕狼形怪物。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","MoZhang","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D14","from":32,"to":32,"text":"白灵小声说：这家伙魔力气息强烈，是个很厉害的怪人，要当心。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"BaiLing","about":["HeiLang","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D15","from":34,"to":35,"text":"怪人形态不限于人形，都会散发魔力气息；但南小风揍过的十几只怪人里，没有一只比得上眼前这只黑狼。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["GuaiRen","HeiLang","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D16","from":36,"to":37,"text":"南小风心里想着赶紧解决掉再回家补作业，魔法少女风信子没有退缩，踏前一步猛冲上前。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["FengXinZi","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D17","from":40,"to":41,"text":"树丛后探出毛茸茸耳朵和小脑袋，苏天晴认真打量正与黑狼怪人战斗的天蓝色魔法少女。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","HeiLang","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D18","from":42,"to":44,"text":"苏天晴评价风信子动作干练、大剑有力、五官可爱、裙子漂亮，但吐槽她穿船袜，认为魔法少女应穿过膝袜。","channel":"thought","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["FengXinZi","MoFaShaonv"]},{"id":"D19","from":45,"to":48,"text":"眼看风信子逐渐占上风，苏天晴尾巴摇动加快，疑惑她怎么快赢了，很想质问秘典给的强化药是不是假的。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["FengXinZi","MoQiuLiMiDian","QiangHuaYaoA","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D20","from":49,"to":50,"text":"苏天晴下午研究墨丘利秘典，发现这个系统能买东西，并获得200神典石启动资金；她花50神典石买下【怪人强化药A】，灌给黑狼怪人。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","MoQiuLiMiDian","ShenDianShi","QiangHuaYaoA","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D21","from":51,"to":54,"text":"苏天晴发现强化过的黑狼竟被风信子全程压着打，便翻看秘典说明，怀疑用法错误；读完最后一行后，她愣了一瞬，重新露出狡黠微笑。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","HeiLang","FengXinZi","MoQiuLiMiDian","QiangHuaYaoA"]},{"id":"D22","from":55,"to":56,"text":"苏天晴心中呢喃“原来如此”，并想：等风信子自以为打败黑狼怪人的时候，才是真正的开始。","channel":"thought","mode":"plan","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["FengXinZi","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D23","from":58,"to":58,"text":"风信子宣布“这样一来——就解决了！”","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["HeiLang"]},{"id":"D24","from":59,"to":60,"text":"大剑劈砍，黑狼怪人头部中剑后倒伏在地，哀嚎几声后没了动静。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["MoZhang","HeiLang","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D25","from":67,"to":70,"text":"白灵关切地飞到风信子身边，洒落魔力粒子帮她恢复体力；南小风说自己没事只是累了；白灵说今天的怪人比以前见过的任何怪人都强。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"BaiLing","about":["BaiLing","FengXinZi","HeiLang","GuaiRen"]},{"id":"D26","from":71,"to":75,"text":"南小风觉得黑狼无论速度还是力量都很强，但总感觉怪怪的；白灵说她的天赋是近战压制，能在肉搏中跟她不分上下的怪人很少见；她疑惑以往怪人或多或少有魔法能力，而眼前这只却没有。","channel":"thought","mode":"conjecture","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["FengXinZi","HeiLang","BaiLing","GuaiRen"]},{"id":"D27","from":76,"to":80,"text":"突然传来清脆鼓掌声，南小风强撑着转身，看见沐浴月光的金色身影：毛茸茸尾巴与耳朵、金色长发、娇小可爱，令她失神。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["FengXinZi","SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D28","from":83,"to":84,"text":"白灵看见小狐狸胸前的金色十字星，认出守护之星，惊呼对方也是魔法少女。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"BaiLing","about":["SuTianQing","ShouHuZhiXing","MoFaShaonv"]},{"id":"D29","from":85,"to":87,"text":"苏天晴轻笑回应“反应过来了吗，真是迟钝呢”，并称赞风信子的战斗很精彩；她心里其实很慌，全靠提前演练才有反派范。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D30","from":88,"to":89,"text":"南小风困惑对方知道自己的代号，追问对方是谁、代号是什么、为什么蓉城会有；她意识到蓉城只有自己一名魔法少女，没有观星者帮助不可能得到守护之星。","channel":"thought","mode":"question","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["FengXinZi","SuTianQing","RongCheng","GuanXingZhe","ShouHuZhiXing","MoFaShaonv"]},{"id":"D31","from":90,"to":90,"text":"苏天晴自称“是反派哦”。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D32","from":92,"to":98,"text":"苏天晴拍掌，黑狼怪人骤然暴起，从口中喷吐无数黑影；风信子的大剑脱手，她整个人被砸得倒飞而出，惊叫这东西好恶心。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","HeiLang","FengXinZi","MoZhang"]},{"id":"D33","from":99,"to":102,"text":"苏天晴得意地说这是她精心准备的小礼物生效了；这是强化药A赋予黑狼怪人的终极能力——能在倒下后发动，第二阶段展开。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing","QiangHuaYaoA","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D34","from":103,"to":104,"text":"南小风大声质问苏天晴想干什么、有什么阴谋。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D35","from":105,"to":106,"text":"苏天晴悠哉走到边上，黑狼放下猎物但仍用利爪束缚风信子；金狐在南小风眼里像小恶魔。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","HeiLang","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D36","from":107,"to":110,"text":"苏天晴问风信子这种感觉是否难忘；南小风质问对方是什么人、用下流手段、有本事堂堂正正对决；她只能加大音量压制被利爪抓住的恐惧，不愿露怯。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi","HeiLang"]},{"id":"D37","from":111,"to":113,"text":"苏天晴说风信子全身软软的嘴却硬，凑近用恶魔低语说：今晚就在这里老实待着吧。","channel":"speech","mode":"assertion","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D38","from":114,"to":115,"text":"风信子失去矜持，哀鸣着叫苏天晴等等、别走。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D39","from":116,"to":119,"text":"狐狐停下脚步饶有兴趣地回头；风信子怔住、脸颊泛红；狐狐微笑着走到她面前歪头问是否有事想说，碧色狐眸中藏着玩味笑意。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D40","from":120,"to":120,"text":"风信子让狐狐快把她放下来。","channel":"speech","mode":"request","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D41","from":121,"to":122,"text":"狐狐提议玩个游戏：若风信子赢就放她下来，若不愿意就不会让它们松开。","channel":"speech","mode":"condition","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D42","from":123,"to":124,"text":"风信子犹豫片刻，询问是什么游戏。","channel":"speech","mode":"question","holder":"FengXinZi","about":["SuTianQing"]},{"id":"D43","from":125,"to":128,"text":"苏天晴走到风信子身后，捏起一根狗尾巴草，轻笑着提出游戏“挠痒痒”，规则是风信子若坚持一分钟不叫出声，狐狐就放她下来。","channel":"speech","mode":"condition","holder":"SuTianQing","about":["SuTianQing","FengXinZi"]},{"id":"D44","from":129,"to":129,"text":"蓉城绿心公园里回荡着少女的哀鸣。","channel":"narrator","mode":"assertion","holder":null,"about":["RongCheng","LvXinGongYuan","FengXinZi"]}],"beats":[{"id":"B1","from":1,"to":1,"gist":"章节标题：第4章
